integrity: Exact analytic formulas derived from regenerative cycles and telegraph first-passage transform; reproducible finite Monte Carlo checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Independent exponential wall residence and desorption return to (x0,-1) are essential; no interacting-particle or finite-time exact distributions claimed. The weak-reset threshold limit is after the stationary long-time limit.
title: Exact adsorption-count noise and wall-occupation covariance phases for a reset run-and-tumble particle
